scope: Attachment after explicit permanent dialog-container disposal only
status: Bounded engineering contract decision under the existing user delegation; retained for independent A01-A10 challenge, not a native/G11 pass
authority: User: strict no required CSS/SCSS changes and sanity-check against ~/cyph; judgment on sufficiently conservative TypeScript API changes is delegated.

evidence_basis.documented_comment: Permanently dispose of this portal host.
evidence_basis.actual_tagged_runtime: CDK16 generic attach rejects a disposed outlet. Its direct typed methods bypass that guard; current public CDK preserves the same bypass. The current owned typed DOM operation uses the stable public generic entry and rejects after disposal. All24 observed combinations are retained in the runtime report.

decision: The supported attachment lifetime ends at dispose() or ngOnDestroy(). Do not offer post-disposal typed attachment as a compatibility guarantee. Preserve the real generic-disposal assertion and make its invocation generic; retain the observed typed paths as explicit factual comparisons. Do not call deprecated current attachDomPortal or inspect private disposed state to reproduce a bypass after permanent retirement.
narrowness: No product implementation, constructor, type signature, selector, component HTML, CSS or SCSS changes are introduced by this decision.
During the supported lifetime, all three real portal kinds are checked for identity, attached state, duplicate rejection and detach/dispose behavior.

Exactly one observed difference is scoped: direct typed DOM attachment after explicit permanent disposal. No exception is granted for normal dialog opening, title changes, closing, focus restoration, borrowed-service ownership or supported attachment.
Cyph source sanity found no direct container or typed portal attachment use. No consumer edits or build results are claimed.
documentation: README.md compatibility section records the terminal lifetime boundary.
